[00:23.900]In the air, in the water,
[00:27.620]the mirror reflects in the tears.

[00:33.476]Fall in weight, heavy like a chain,
[00:38.100]choking on the ash and the rain,
[00:40.029]with the words I can't say.
[00:43.211]In the frozen night,
[00:44.554]armored by battles I cannot defy,
[00:46.675]soar over mountains and over the sky.
[00:48.964]Wither in my eyes, and the petals die.

[00:51.869]only white,
[00:53.190]why there's only blight?

[00:56.279]blurring the answers I gave to myself.

[00:59.419]old lines faintly show.

[01:04.996]folds a blossom in your arms.
